scope: exploratory development follow-up designed after R1, historically consumed labels
threshold_fitting_role: probability_calibration only, maximize sample F1, first grid entry breaks ties
canonical_species_ties: descending calibrated probability then ascending species-column index
D2_comparisons: each saved member and mean ensemble, same folds/roles/decoder, individual seed results separated from ensemble
D3_selection: highest mean supported-country macro selective F1 on spatial out-of-fold risk-calibration predictions; fixed ordering breaks ties, global first
coverage_policy: same largest-remainder fold/country/area quotas as R1
limitations: No retrospective change to failed R1 safeguard
Probability calibration and threshold share their assigned role, separate from risk calibration
Disagreement and model averaging are distinct comparisons
replication_new_training: not admitted by this diagnostic protocol
